model: R801P upflow/horizontal 80% gas furnace (R801PA050314 to R801PA150524)
notes: Covers the five R801P sizes, 50,000 to 150,000 Btu/h input, in the standard (S) and low-NOx (X) versions, which the parts list gives the same part numbers. Blower motor ratings change by size, from 1/3 HP on the 50 size to 3/4 HP on the 125 and 150 sizes; all sizes are 115 V, 60 Hz, single phase.

gaps: The parts list is the 22-September-2014 revision; its header points to rheempartslists.net for the current revision, which did not load. The spec sheet is Form G11-543, printed 6/14.
The parts list's model key prints the 100 size as 98,000 Btu/h; the spec sheet prints 100,000.
The spec sheet states 115 V, 60 Hz, 1 phase for all models, not for the blower motor, so no v is set on the motor.
The motor watts are the figures the spec sheet prints in square brackets, which the sheet says are metric conversions of the horsepower ratings.
The flame sensor, spark ignitor and control board are listed once under Gas Controls (gas code JF), not by size.

The installation instructions name the maker only through a myrheem.com reference; their title covers the (-)801S and (-)801P series and their airflow table lists (-)801PA050314MSA to 125524MSA (the 150 row is printed as 801SA).

Not claimed: blower motor OEM numbers (51-104939-01 to 51-104941-02), transformer 46-24124-06 and gas valve 60-105055-01, since those lines cite other documents; capacitor ratings, pressure switch setpoint, limit temperatures and ignitor resistance are not printed in the sources read.
method: Rheem R801P-MSA,MXA Parts List, 92-42800-R801P-MSA,MXA (22-September-2014), Rheem logo on the cover; copy on resource.bakerdist.com (Watsco). Pages 3 to 6 used.
Rheem Classic Series R801P (UF/HZ) Upflow/Horizontal Gas Furnace specification sheet, Form G11-543 (6/14), same host. Pages 1, 3 and 4 used, page 4 rendered as an image.
Rheem installation instructions ST-A1220 for (-)801S and (-)801P upflow/horizontal single-stage furnaces, same host; page 25 gas valve text and the page 46 airflow table used.
No Rheem-hosted copy was found; rheempartslists.net did not load. youngsupply.com (HTTP 403) and supplystop.com (HTTP 429) refused the researcher.

comps.spec: Direct-drive PSC blower motor, 4 speeds, by size: 1/3 HP [248 W], 5.7 full load amps (050); 1/2 HP [373 W], 7.8 A (075) and 7.5 A (100); 3/4 HP [560 W], 8.4 A (125) and 9.3 A (150)
Blower wheel, diameter x width as printed: 11 x 6 (050), 11 x 7 (075), 11 x 10 (100, 125, 150)
Blower motor capacitor, OEM 43-101666-57, the same part listed for all five sizes
Transformer rated 40 VA, fitted with a cooling/heating relay and described as ready for air conditioning applications
24-volt gas valve, per the installation instructions for the (-)801S and (-)801P series
Flame sensor, OEM 62-23543-01, listed once under Gas Controls (gas code JF)
Pressure switch assembly, OEM 42-101082-01 (all five sizes)
Spark ignitor, OEM 62-24164-03, listed once under Gas Controls (gas code JF)
Integrated furnace control board (IFC), OEM 62-104058-02, listed once under Gas Controls (gas code JF)
Main limit on the heat exchanger panel, OEM 47-104990-01 (050) or 47-104990-04 (075 to 150)
Manual-reset limit in the burner compartment, OEM 47-22861-03, listed with quantity (2) for all five sizes
Heat-assisted limit in the blower housing, OEM 47-22860-06 (all five sizes)
Push-button door switch, OEM 42-22692-09 (all five sizes)
Induced draft blower (IDB) with gasket, OEM 70-101087-01; the gasket is also listed separately as 68-22850-01 (all five sizes)
Removable heat exchanger; the spec sheet's heat exchanger feature bullet gives aluminized steel construction
